description: This file defines a class `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateAccountNameButton` that extends `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate`. It is responsible for rendering a button in the subpanel interface of the CRM system, allowing users to create a new Account name (Contact) with pre-filled address and phone details based on the current context. The class includes methods for generating the widget ID and displaying the button with appropriate form fields and access controls.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateAccountNameButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Create Account Name' button in subpanels within the CRM interface, with logic for access control and pre-filling form data.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns the widget ID, optionally with a suffix. It calls the parent class's method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the create account button, including access control checks and pre-filling address and phone fields based on the current context.
